intro.en: This reading says cleanliness is needed in everything. Islam urges us to keep our body, clothes, home, mosque and streets clean. Notice how purity is a condition for prayer and for touching the Quran.
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein hum parhenge ke safai har cheez mein zaroori hai. Islam hamein apna jism, kapde, ghar, masjid aur raste saaf rakhne ka hukm deta hai. Dhyan dein: namaz aur Quran ko chhoone ke liye paaki shart hai.
intro.ar: تُبَيِّنُ هَذِهِ القِراءَةُ أَنَّ النَّظافَةَ مَطْلوبَةٌ في كُلِّ شَيْءٍ، فَالإِسْلامُ يَحُثُّنا عَلى نَظافَةِ البَدَنِ وَالثِّيابِ وَالبَيْتِ وَالمَسْجِدِ وَالشّارِعِ. وَلاحِظْ أَنَّ الطَّهارَةَ شَرْطٌ لِلصَّلاةِ.

dialogue.ar: النَّظافَةُ ضَرورِيَّةٌ في كُلِّ شَيْءٍ.
dialogue.tr: an-naẓāfatu ḍarūriyyatun fī kulli shay'
dialogue.en: Cleanliness is necessary in everything.
dialogue.ur: Safai har cheez mein zaroori hai.

dialogue.ar: وَقَدْ حَثَّ الدِّينُ عَلى نَظافَةِ أَجْسامِنا وَمَسْكَنِنا وَمَسْجِدِنا وَمَلابِسِنا.
dialogue.tr: wa qad ḥaththa d-dīnu ʿalā naẓāfati ajsāminā
dialogue.en: Religion urged us to keep our bodies, homes, mosque and clothes clean.
dialogue.ur: Deen ne hamare jism, ghar, masjid aur kapdon ki safai par ubhaara hai.

dialogue.ar: وَقَدْ جَعَلَ اللهُ النَّظافَةَ وَالطَّهارَةَ شَرْطاً لا تَتِمُّ بَعْضُ العِباداتِ إِلّا بِهِ.
dialogue.tr: wa qad jaʿala llāhu n-naẓāfata wa ṭ-ṭahārata sharṭan
dialogue.en: Allah made cleanliness and purity a condition without which some acts of worship are not complete.
dialogue.ur: Allah ne safai aur paaki ko shart banaya, jis ke baghair kuch ibadaat mukammal nahin hotin.

dialogue.ar: فَالصَّلاةُ لا تُقْبَلُ إِلّا بِالطَّهارَةِ.
dialogue.tr: fa-ṣ-ṣalātu lā tuqbalu illā bi-ṭ-ṭahāra
dialogue.en: Prayer is not accepted without purity.
dialogue.ur: Namaz paaki ke baghair qabool nahin hoti.

dialogue.ar: وَلا يُمَسُّ المُصْحَفُ إِلّا بِطَهارَةٍ.
dialogue.tr: wa lā yumassu l-muṣḥafu illā bi-ṭahāra
dialogue.en: The Quran is not touched except in a state of purity.
dialogue.ur: Mushaf ko paaki ke baghair haath nahin lagaya jata.

dialogue.ar: كانَ الرَّسولُ يَحْرِصُ عَلى أَنْ يَكونَ المُسْلِمُ نَظيفاً في مَلابِسِهِ وَجَسَدِهِ.
dialogue.tr: kāna r-rasūlu yaḥriṣu ʿalā an yakūna l-muslimu naẓīfan
dialogue.en: The Messenger wanted the Muslim to be clean in his clothes and body.
dialogue.ur: Rasool chahte the ke musalman apne kapdon aur jism mein saaf suthra ho.

dialogue.ar: يَقولُ: «السِّواكُ مَطْهَرَةٌ لِلْفَمِ، مَرْضاةٌ لِلرَّبِّ».
dialogue.tr: yaqūlu: as-siwāku maṭharatun lil-fam, marḍātun lir-rabb
dialogue.en: He said: the siwak cleans the mouth and pleases the Lord.
dialogue.ur: Farmaya: miswaak munh ko paak karta hai aur Rab ko raazi karta hai.

dialogue.ar: وَجاءَ الإِسْلامُ بِسُنَنِ الفِطْرَةِ، وَفيها إِزالَةُ زَوائِدِ الجِسْمِ الَّتي قَدْ تُجَمِّعُ الأَوْساخَ.
dialogue.tr: wa jāʾa l-islāmu bi-sunani l-fiṭra
dialogue.en: Islam brought the practices of natural cleanliness, which remove body parts that collect dirt.
dialogue.ur: Islam fitrat ki sunnatein laya, jin mein jism ke un hisson ko door karna hai jin mein mail jama hota hai.

dialogue.ar: وَالإِسْلامُ يَدْعو النّاسَ إِلى أَنْ يُحافِظوا عَلى نَظافَةِ الأَماكِنِ كَالبُيوتِ وَالمَساجِدِ وَالطُّرُقاتِ.
dialogue.tr: wal-islāmu yadʿū n-nāsa ilā an yuḥāfiẓū ʿalā naẓāfati l-amākin
dialogue.en: Islam calls people to keep places clean, such as homes, mosques and roads.
dialogue.ur: Islam logon ko bulata hai ke jagahon, jaise ghar, masjid aur sadkon, ko saaf rakhein.

dialogue.ar: وَقَدْ دَعا الرَّسولُ إِلى إِزالَةِ ما يُؤْذي النّاسَ مِنَ الطَّريقِ.
dialogue.tr: wa qad daʿā r-rasūlu ilā izālati mā yuʾdī n-nāsa mina ṭ-ṭarīq
dialogue.en: The Messenger called us to remove from the road whatever harms people.
dialogue.ur: Rasool ne raste se woh cheez hataane ko kaha jo logon ko takleef de.

q.en: What does the text say is necessary in everything?
q.ur: Text ke mutabiq har cheez mein kya zaroori hai?
q.ar: ما الَّذي يَقولُ النَّصُّ إِنَّهُ ضَرورِيٌّ في كُلِّ شَيْءٍ؟

options: Cleaning the mouth / Munh ki safai
Sweeping the road / Sadak saaf karna

options_ar: ما في الفَمِ وَنَمْضُغُ بِهِ الطَّعامَ

q.ur: Namaz ke baghair kya qabool nahin?

q.en: What did the Messenger call us to remove from the road?
q.ur: Rasool ne raste se kya hataane ko kaha?
q.ar: ماذا دَعانا الرَّسولُ ﷺ إِلى إِزالَتِهِ عَنِ الطَّريقِ؟

options: What harms people / Jo takleef de

intro.en: Wonder (ta'ajjub) is expressed with «ما أَفْعَلَ ...!». Take a verb like جَمُلَ (to be beautiful) and say «ما أَجْمَلَ السَّماءَ!» - How beautiful the sky is! Another form is «أَفْعِلْ بِـ ...!», e.g. «أَجْمِلْ بِهِ!». Then practise turning verbs and sentences into wonder sentences.
intro.ur: Ta'ajjub (hairat) «ما أَفْعَلَ ...!» se zaahir kiya jata hai. Misaal: «ما أَجْمَلَ السَّماءَ!» yani aasman kitna khoobsurat hai! Doosra andaaz «أَفْعِلْ بِـ ...!» hai, jaise «أَجْمِلْ بِهِ!». Phir mashq mein fe'l aur jumlon ko ta'ajjub ke jumlon mein badalna hai.
intro.ar: نُعَبِّرُ عَنِ التَّعَجُّبِ بِصيغَةِ «ما أَفْعَلَ ...!». نَأْخُذُ فِعْلًا مِثْلَ «جَمُلَ» وَنَقولُ «ما أَجْمَلَ السَّماءَ!». وَصيغَةٌ أُخْرى هِيَ «أَفْعِلْ بِـ ...!» مِثْلُ «أَجْمِلْ بِهِ!». ثُمَّ تَتَدَرَّبُ عَلى تَحْويلِ الأَفْعالِ وَالجُمَلِ إِلى جُمَلِ تَعَجُّبٍ.

dialogue.ar: ما أَجْمَلَ السَّماءَ!
dialogue.tr: mā ajmala s-samāʾ
dialogue.en: How beautiful the sky is!
dialogue.ur: Aasman kitna khoobsurat hai!

dialogue.ar: ما أَوْسَعَ الأَمَلَ!
dialogue.tr: mā awsaʿa l-amal
dialogue.en: How wide hope is!
dialogue.ur: Umeed kitni wasee hai!

dialogue.ar: ما أَحْسَنَ الاسْتِقامَةَ!
dialogue.tr: mā aḥsana l-istiqāma
dialogue.en: How good uprightness is!
dialogue.ur: Istiqamat kitni acchi cheez hai!

dialogue.ar: ما أَعْدَلَ القاضِيَ!
dialogue.tr: mā aʿdala l-qāḍī
dialogue.en: How just the judge is!
dialogue.ur: Qaazi kitna insaaf-pasand hai!

dialogue.ar: أَجْمِلْ بِهِ مِنْ مَكانٍ!
dialogue.tr: ajmil bihi min makān
dialogue.en: How beautiful this place is!
dialogue.ur: Yeh jagah kitni khoobsurat hai!

dialogue.ar: أَقْبِحْ بِالبُخْلِ!
dialogue.tr: aqbiḥ bil-bukhl
dialogue.en: How ugly stinginess is!
dialogue.ur: Bukhl kitni buri cheez hai!

dialogue.ar: ما أَشَدَّ ازْدِحامَ هَذا الشّارِعِ!
dialogue.tr: mā ashadda zdiḥāma hādhā sh-shāriʿ
dialogue.en: How heavy the traffic of this street is!
dialogue.ur: Is sadak ka hujoom kitna zyada hai!

dialogue.ar: ما أَشَدَّ حُمْرَةَ الوَرْدِ!
dialogue.tr: mā ashadda ḥumrata l-ward
dialogue.en: How red the rose is!
dialogue.ur: Gulaab kitna surkh hai!

dialogue.ar: ما أَقْبَحَ أَنْ يَتْرُكَ المُسْلِمُ صَلاتَهُ!
dialogue.tr: mā aqbaḥa an yatruka l-muslimu ṣalātah
dialogue.en: How ugly it is for a Muslim to leave his prayer!
dialogue.ur: Musalman ka apni namaz chhod dena kitna bura hai!

dialogue.ar: ما أَنْفَعَ أَنْ يُبْذَلَ المالُ في الخَيْرِ!
dialogue.tr: mā anfaʿa an yubdhala l-mālu fil-khayr
dialogue.en: How beneficial it is to spend money on good!
dialogue.ur: Maal ko bhalai mein kharch karna kitna faida-mand hai!

dialogue.ar: لِلّهِ دَرُّكَ مِنْ بَطَلٍ!
dialogue.tr: lillāhi darruka min baṭal
dialogue.en: Allah bless you, what a hero!
dialogue.ur: Subhan Allah, tum kya hi bahadur ho!

dialogue.ar: سُبْحانَ اللهِ!
dialogue.tr: subḥāna llāh
dialogue.en: Glory be to Allah!
dialogue.ur: Subhan Allah!

q.ur: Kaun sa jumla ta'ajjub ka hai?

options: How good uprightness is! / Istiqamat kitni acchi hai!
What is uprightness? / Istiqamat kya hai?
He is upright / Woh seedha hai

q.en: The second form of wonder starts with:
q.ur: Ta'ajjub ki doosri shakl kis se shuru hoti hai?
Kaun sa jumla tareef ke liye hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ عِبارَةٍ تُقالُ لِلثَّناءِ عَلى شَخْصٍ؟

title.en: Listening: The Ant and the Sweets; Abu Sufyan and Heraclius
title.ur: Sunna: Cheenti aur mithai; Abu Sufyan aur Heraclius

intro.en: Here you listen to two texts and answer true/false questions: a story about ants and a sweet (الحَلْوى) in the forest, and the famous meeting of Abu Sufyan with Heraclius (هِرَقْل), the ruler of the Romans, who asked him about Muhammad. Play the audio, then check the answers.
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein do matn sun kar sahi/ghalat ke sawalat hal karne hain: ek cheentiyon aur mithai ki kahani, aur doosra Abu Sufyan aur Heraclius (Rome ke badshah) ki mashhoor mulaqat, jis mein usne Muhammad ﷺ ke baare mein poocha. Audio sunein, phir jawab dekhein.
intro.ar: في هَذا الدَّرْسِ تَسْتَمِعُ إِلى نَصَّيْنِ وَتُجيبُ عَنْ أَسْئِلَةِ الصَّوابِ وَالخَطَأِ: قِصَّةُ النَّمْلِ وَالحَلْوى في الغابَةِ، وَلِقاءُ أَبي سُفْيانَ بِهِرَقْلَ مَلِكِ الرّومِ الَّذي سَأَلَهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ ﷺ. شَغِّلِ الصَّوْتَ ثُمَّ تَحَقَّقْ مِنَ الإِجاباتِ.

options: Ruler of the Romans / Rumiyon ka badshah

q.en: Heraclius sent for Abu Sufyan to ask him about...
q.ur: Heraclius ne Abu Sufyan ko kis ke baare mein poochne bulaya?
q.ar: اسْتَدْعى هِرَقْلُ أَبا سُفْيانَ لِيَسْأَلَهُ عَنْ...

intro.en: This section gives tips for a good speech (khutba) and then asks you to prepare and deliver one. Good speeches are prepared, stay on one topic, use clear Arabic, give proofs and examples, and are not too long.
intro.ur: Is hisse mein achi khutba ke liye mashwarey hain, phir khutba tayyar karke sunana hai. Achi khutba pehle se tayyar hoti hai, ek mauzu par rehti hai, saaf Arabic mein hoti hai, daleel aur misaal deti hai aur lambi nahin hoti.
intro.ar: يُقَدِّمُ هَذا القِسْمُ نَصائِحَ لِلخُطْبَةِ الجَيِّدَةِ ثُمَّ يَطْلُبُ مِنْكَ أَنْ تُعِدَّ خُطْبَةً وَتُلْقِيَها. الخُطْبَةُ الجَيِّدَةُ مُعَدَّةٌ، وَتَدورُ حَوْلَ مَوْضوعٍ واحِدٍ، وَبِعَرَبِيَّةٍ واضِحَةٍ، وَفيها أَدِلَّةٌ وَأَمْثِلَةٌ، وَلَيْسَتْ طَويلَةً.

dialogue.ar: إِعْدادُ الخُطْبَةِ قَبْلَ إِلْقائِها يُتيحُ لِلْخَطيبِ تَرْتيبَ أَفْكارِهِ.
dialogue.tr: iʿdādu l-khuṭba qabla ilqāʾihā yutīḥu lil-khaṭīb tartība afkārih
dialogue.en: Preparing the speech before giving it lets the speaker arrange his ideas.
dialogue.ur: Khutba se pehle uski tayyari khatib ko khayalat tarteeb dene deti hai.

dialogue.ar: وَحْدَةُ مَوْضوعِ الخُطْبَةِ تُتيحُ لِلْخَطيبِ التَّرْكيزَ.
dialogue.tr: waḥdatu mawḍūʿi l-khuṭba tutīḥu lil-khaṭīb at-tarkīz
dialogue.en: A single topic lets the speaker focus.
dialogue.ur: Ek mauzu par rehna khatib ko tawajjuh ka mauqa deta hai.

dialogue.ar: صِحَّةُ اللُّغَةِ وَجَمالُ أُسْلوبِها: أَنْ تَكونَ عَرَبِيَّةً فَصيحَةً بِأُسْلوبٍ سَهْلٍ.
dialogue.tr: ṣiḥḥatu l-lugha wa jamālu uslūbihā
dialogue.en: Correct language and a beautiful style: clear Arabic in an easy manner.
dialogue.ur: Zubaan ki durusti aur khoobsurat andaaz: saaf fasih Arabic, aasaan tareeqe se.

dialogue.ar: الاسْتِشْهادُ بِالأَدِلَّةِ وَضَرْبُ الأَمْثالِ أَوْقَعُ في النُّفوسِ.
dialogue.tr: al-istishhādu bil-adilla wa ḍarbu l-amthāl awqaʿu fin-nufūs
dialogue.en: Using proofs and examples has more effect on people's hearts.
dialogue.ur: Daleelein aur misalein dilon par zyada asar karti hain.

dialogue.ar: عَدَمُ الإِطالَةِ: فَالخُطْبَةُ الطَّويلَةُ يَمَلُّها السّامِعونَ.
dialogue.tr: ʿadamu l-iṭāla: fal-khuṭbatu ṭ-ṭawīla yamilluhā s-sāmiʿūn
dialogue.en: Do not be long: listeners get bored of a long speech.
dialogue.ur: Lambi na karein: lambi khutba se sunne wale ukta jate hain.

dialogue.ar: أَشْهَرُ الخُطَبِ عِنْدَ المُسْلِمينَ خُطْبَةُ الجُمُعَةِ.
dialogue.tr: ashharu l-khuṭabi ʿind al-muslimīn khuṭbatu l-jumuʿa
dialogue.en: The best-known speech among Muslims is the Friday sermon.
dialogue.ur: Musalmanon mein sab se mashhoor khutba Jumu'a ka khutba hai.

q.en: What does the text say about a long speech?
q.ur: Lambi khutba ke baare mein kya kaha?
q.ar: ماذا يَقولُ النَّصُّ عَنِ الخُطْبَةِ الطَّويلَةِ؟

options: Listeners get bored / Sunne wale ukta jate hain

q.en: Which language should a speech use?
What do proofs and examples do?
q.ur: Daleel aur misalein kya karti hain?

options: Affect hearts more / Dilon par zyada asar
Make it boring / Bore karti hain
Make it longer / Lamba karti hain

q.en: Which speech do Muslims hear every week?
q.ur: Musalman har hafte kaun sa khutba sunte hain?
q.ar: أَيُّ خُطْبَةٍ يَسْمَعُها المُسْلِمونَ كُلَّ أُسْبوعٍ؟

intro.en: Arabic has several negation words: ما، لا، لَمْ، لَمّا، لَنْ، لَيْسَ، غَيْر. Each has its own job. For example «لَمْ يَحْضُرِ الطُّلابُ» (the students did not come - past) and «لَنْ يَجْلِسَ هُنا» (he will never sit here - future). Compare the same sentence with different tools.
intro.ur: Arabic mein nafi (inkaar) ke kai alfaaz hain: ما، لا، لَمْ، لَمّا، لَنْ، لَيْسَ، غَيْر. Har ka apna kaam hai. Misaal: «لَمْ يَحْضُرِ الطُّلابُ» (talib-ilm nahin aaye - maazi) aur «لَنْ يَجْلِسَ هُنا» (woh yahan hargiz nahin baithega - mustaqbil). Ek hi jumle ko mukhtalif alfaaz ke saath dekhein.
intro.ar: لِلنَّفْيِ في العَرَبِيَّةِ أَدَواتٌ كَثيرَةٌ: ما، لا، لَمْ، لَمّا، لَنْ، لَيْسَ، غَيْر. وَلِكُلٍّ مِنْها عَمَلُها. مِثالُ ذَلِكَ «لَمْ يَحْضُرِ الطُّلّابُ» (نَفْيُ الماضي) وَ«لَنْ يَجْلِسَ هُنا» (نَفْيُ المُسْتَقْبَلِ). قارِنْ بَيْنَ الجُمْلَةِ نَفْسِها بِأَدَواتٍ مُخْتَلِفَةٍ.

dialogue.ar: حَضَرَ الطُّلابُ. ← ما حَضَرَ الطُّلابُ. ← لَمْ يَحْضُرِ الطُّلابُ.
dialogue.tr: ḥaḍara ṭ-ṭullāb → mā ḥaḍara → lam yaḥḍuri ṭ-ṭullāb
dialogue.en: The students came. → The students did not come (two ways).
dialogue.ur: Talib-ilm aaye. → Talib-ilm nahin aaye (do tareeqe).

dialogue.ar: عِنْدي كِتابٌ. ← ما عِنْدي كِتابٌ. ← لَيْسَ عِنْدي كِتابٌ.
dialogue.tr: ʿindī kitāb → mā ʿindī kitāb → laysa ʿindī kitāb
dialogue.en: I have a book. → I do not have a book.
dialogue.ur: Mere paas kitaab hai. → Mere paas kitaab nahin.

dialogue.ar: عُثْمانُ مُهْتَمٌّ بِالمَوْضوعِ. ← عُثْمانُ غَيْرُ مُهْتَمٍّ بِالمَوْضوعِ.
dialogue.tr: ʿuthmānu muhtammun bil-mawḍūʿ → ghayru muhtamm
dialogue.en: Uthman is interested. → Uthman is not interested.
dialogue.ur: Usman dilchaspi rakhta hai. → Usman dilchaspi nahin rakhta.

dialogue.ar: أَنا أَعْرِفُكَ. ← أَنا لا أَعْرِفُكَ.
dialogue.tr: anā aʿrifuk → anā lā aʿrifuk
dialogue.en: I know you. → I do not know you.
dialogue.ur: Main tumhein jaanta hoon. → Main tumhein nahin jaanta.

dialogue.ar: لَمْ تَطْلُعِ الشَّمْسُ. ← لَمّا تَطْلُعِ الشَّمْسُ بَعْدُ.
dialogue.tr: lam taṭluʿi sh-shams → lammā taṭluʿ ash-shams baʿd
dialogue.en: The sun did not rise. → The sun has not risen yet.
dialogue.ur: Sooraj nahin nikla. → Sooraj abhi tak nahin nikla.

dialogue.ar: عَلِيٌّ يَجْلِسُ هُنا. ← عَلِيٌّ لَنْ يَجْلِسَ هُنا.
dialogue.tr: ʿaliyyun yajlisu hunā → lan yajlisa hunā
dialogue.en: Ali sits here. → Ali will never sit here.
dialogue.ur: Ali yahan baithta hai. → Ali yahan hargiz nahin baithega.

dialogue.ar: ﴿لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ﴾
dialogue.tr: lam yalid wa lam yūlad
dialogue.en: He neither begets nor is born.
dialogue.ur: Na us ne kisi ko jana, na woh jana gaya.

q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ تَنْفي المُسْتَقْبَلَ نَفْيًا مُؤَكَّدًا؟

q.en: Which word negates the past with a jussive verb?
q.ur: Maazi ki nafi jazm wale fe'l ke saath kaun si hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ تَنْفي الماضِيَ مَعَ فِعْلٍ مَجْزومٍ؟
أَيُّ أَداةٍ تُفيدُ نَفْيَ الشَّيْءِ إِلى الآنَ مَعَ تَوَقُّعِ حُدوثِهِ؟

title.en: Extended Reading: A Lady of Banu Umayya
title.ur: Parhna: Banu Umayya ki ek khatoon

intro.en: This story is about Fatima bint Abd al-Malik, wife of the caliph Umar ibn Abd al-Aziz. When Umar became caliph he chose a simple life and gave back what belonged to the Muslims. Fatima chose to stay with him. Read how they lived with little, and what it teaches about fear of Allah and justice.
intro.ur: Yeh kahani Fatima bint Abd al-Malik ki hai, jo khalifa Umar bin Abd al-Aziz ki biwi thin. Jab Umar khalifa bane to unhon ne saada zindagi chuni aur musalmanon ka maal wapas kar diya. Fatima ne unke saath rehna chuna. Parhein ke woh kam par kaise guzara karte the aur is se Allah ke khauf aur insaaf ka kya sabaq milta hai.
intro.ar: قِصَّةٌ عَنْ فاطِمَةَ بِنْتِ عَبْدِ المَلِكِ زَوْجَةِ الخَليفَةِ عُمَرَ بْنِ عَبْدِ العَزيزِ. لَمّا صارَ عُمَرُ خَليفَةً اخْتارَ حَياةً بَسيطَةً وَرَدَّ ما هُوَ لِلمُسْلِمينَ، وَاخْتارَتْ فاطِمَةُ البَقاءَ مَعَهُ. اِقْرَأْ كَيْفَ عاشا بِالقَليلِ، وَما تُعَلِّمُنا عَنْ خَشْيَةِ اللهِ وَالعَدْلِ.

dialogue.ar: كانَتْ فاطِمَةُ بِنْتُ عَبْدِ المَلِكِ تَجْلِسُ في طَرَفِ المَجْلِسِ.
dialogue.tr: kānat Fāṭimatu bintu ʿAbdi l-Malik tajlisu fī ṭarafi l-majlis
dialogue.en: Fatima bint Abd al-Malik was sitting at the edge of the gathering.
dialogue.ur: Fatima bint Abd al-Malik majlis ke kinare baithi thi.

dialogue.ar: وَإِذا بِصَوْتَيْنِ يَمْلآنِ جَوانِبَ القَصْرِ: صَوْتُ الفَجيعَةِ وَالأَلَمِ، وَصَوْتُ البِشارَةِ.
dialogue.tr: wa idhā bi-ṣawtayn yamlāʾāni jawānib al-qaṣr
dialogue.en: Two sounds filled the palace: one of grief and one of good news.
dialogue.ur: Achanak do aawazein mehal mein goonjin: ek gham ki aur ek khushkhabri ki.

dialogue.ar: قالَ عُمَرُ لِزَوْجَتِهِ: يا فاطِمَةُ، قَدْ نَزَلَ بي هَذا الأَمْرُ، وَحُمِّلْتُ أَثْقَلَ حِمْلٍ.
dialogue.tr: qāla ʿUmaru li-zawjatih: yā Fāṭima, qad nazala bī hādhā l-amr
dialogue.en: Umar said to his wife: Fatima, this matter has fallen on me, and I carry a very heavy load.
dialogue.ur: Umar ne biwi se kaha: Fatima, yeh zimmedari mujh par aa padi hai, aur mujh par bohat bhaari bojh hai.

dialogue.ar: إِنْ شِئْتِ سَيَّرْتُكِ إِلى دارِ أَبيكِ.
dialogue.tr: in shiʾti sayyartuki ilā dāri abīk
dialogue.en: If you wish, I will send you to your father's house.
dialogue.ur: Agar chaho to main tumhein tumhare walid ke ghar bhej doon.

dialogue.ar: قالَ: إِنَّ لي نَفْساً تَوّاقَةً، وَما نِلْتُ شَيْئاً إِلّا اشْتَهَيْتُ ما هُوَ خَيْرٌ مِنْهُ.
dialogue.tr: inna lī nafsan tawwāqa, wa mā niltu shayʾan illā ishtahaytu mā huwa khayrun minh
dialogue.en: He said: My soul is eager; whenever I got something I desired something better.
dialogue.ur: Kaha: Mera nafs bohat shauq rakhta hai; jo bhi paya us se behtar ki khwahish hui.

dialogue.ar: فَلَمّا نِلْتُها اشْتَهَيْتُ ما هُوَ خَيْرٌ مِنْها وَهُوَ الجَنَّةُ.
dialogue.tr: fa-lammā niltuhā ishtahaytu mā huwa khayrun minhā wa huwa l-janna
dialogue.en: When I reached it, I desired what is better: Paradise.
dialogue.ur: Jab main ne use paa liya to us se behtar cheez chahi, aur woh Jannat hai.

dialogue.ar: قالَتْ فاطِمَةُ: اِصْنَعْ ما تَراهُ، فَأَنا مَعَكَ.
dialogue.tr: qālat Fāṭima: iṣnaʿ mā tarāh, fa-anā maʿak
dialogue.en: Fatima said: Do what you see fit, I am with you.
dialogue.ur: Fatima ne kaha: Jo aap munasib samjhein karein, main aap ke saath hoon.

dialogue.ar: فَأَعْتَقَ الإِماءَ وَالعَبيدَ، وَسَرَّحَ الخَدَمَ، وَتَرَكَ القَصْرَ، وَسَكَنَ داراً صَغيرَةً.
dialogue.tr: fa-aʿtaqa l-imāʾa wal-ʿabīd, wa tarak al-qaṣr, wa sakana dāran ṣaghīra
dialogue.en: He freed the slaves, dismissed the servants, left the palace and lived in a small house.
dialogue.ur: Unhon ne ghulam aur laundiyan azaad kin, naukar rukhsat kiye, mehal chhoda aur chhote ghar mein rahe.

dialogue.ar: وَقالَتْ: وَاللهِ ما لَهُ قَميصٌ غَيْرُهُ!
dialogue.tr: wa qālat: wallāhi mā lahu qamīṣun ghayruh
dialogue.en: She said: By Allah, he has no other shirt!
dialogue.ur: Kaha: Allah ki qasam, unke paas us ke siwa koi qameez nahin!

dialogue.ar: قالَتْ فاطِمَةُ: يا بُنَيَّ، هَذا طَعامُ مَوْلاكَ أَميرِ المُؤْمِنينَ.
dialogue.tr: qālat Fāṭima: yā bunayy, hādhā ṭaʿāmu mawlāka amīri l-muʾminīn
dialogue.en: Fatima said: My son, this is the food of your master, the Commander of the Faithful.
dialogue.ur: Fatima ne kaha: Beta, yeh tumhare aaqa Ameer ul-Momineen ka khana hai.

dialogue.ar: قالَتْ: لا وَاللهِ أَبَداً، ما كُنْتُ لِأُطيعَهُ حَيّاً وَأَعْصِيَهُ مَيِّتاً.
dialogue.tr: qālat: lā wallāhi abadan, mā kuntu li-uṭīʿahu ḥayyan wa aʿṣiyahu mayyitan
dialogue.en: She said: Never, by Allah! I would not obey him alive and disobey him dead.
dialogue.ur: Kaha: Allah ki qasam hargiz nahin, main unki zindagi mein itaat karun aur wafaat ke baad na-farmani, aisa nahin ho sakta.

dialogue.ar: رَحْمَةُ اللهِ عَلى أُولَئِكَ. أُولَئِكَ وَاللهِ هُمُ النّاسُ.
dialogue.tr: raḥmatu llāhi ʿalā ulāʾik. ulāʾika wallāhi humu n-nās
dialogue.en: Allah's mercy on them. By Allah, those are the real people.
dialogue.ur: Allah ki rehmat ho un par. Allah ki qasam, yahi asal insaan hain.

q.ur: Kahani kis ke baare mein hai?

options: Fatima and Umar ibn Abd al-Aziz

q.en: What did Umar do when he became caliph?
q.ur: Khalifa banne par Umar ne kya kiya?
q.ar: ماذا فَعَلَ عُمَرُ حينَ صارَ خَليفَةً؟

options: Left the palace for a small house / Chhote ghar mein chale gaye
Built a bigger palace / Bada mehal banaya
To stay with Umar / Umar ke saath rehna
To go to her father's house / Walid ke ghar jana
To keep the jewels / Zewar rakhna

q.en: What did Fatima do with her jewels?
q.ur: Fatima ne apne zewar ka kya kiya?

options: Returned them to the treasury (بَيْتُ المالِ)
Gave them to servants / Naukron ko diye
